concepts.name: Temporal Attention
concepts.summary: The one new component of video diffusion. Fix a spatial position (i, j) and gather its vector from every one of the T frames; run self-attention over just those T tokens, for every position. Thus each spatial position attends to ITSELF across time, so position (i, j) in a later frame knows what it looked like in earlier frames. This is the entire cure for flicker: it is the only self-attention image diffusion lacked, and temporal consistency is exactly what it buys.

concepts.name: Factorized Spatial+Temporal Attention
concepts.summary: Replacing one full joint 3D attention over all T·h·w positions (cost O((T·h·w)^2), explosive) with two cheaper passes: SPATIAL attention fixes a frame and attends over its h·w tokens at cost O((h·w)^2), and TEMPORAL attention fixes a position and attends over its T frames at cost O(T^2). The factorized cost is (h·w)^2 + T^2 rather than (T·h·w)^2, dramatically cheaper, in the same anti-quadratic spirit as the rest of the attention-cost work.
